text:
sophia: quick idea — add a 'quarantine' lane in Rollouts that collects sampled requests that triggered automatic fallback. a lightweight place for the first-pass review before an operator override. thoughts?

jamal: love it. is this just another name for the playback sandbox or different?

oliver: different. playback replays inputs to a secondary model. quarantine = triage inbox: short snippets, reason tags, and operator annotations. low friction.

maria: UI nit: show reason tags (latency / model_exception / rate_limit), timestamp, route, model-variant, and a redacted snippet (first ~200 chars). make it filterable.

sophia: + display the classifier label that triggered the fallback e.g. `response_error: out_of_memory` or `latency: >500ms`. include a link to the decision trace (click-to-open).

jamal: big privacy question — quarantine will surface user inputs. how do we avoid PII leakage in the UI?

oliver: we should strip/obfuscate server-side by default. show a redacted snippet and a `replay (masked)` button. full payload only in audit logs with very restricted perms.

maria: telemetry/cost note — sampling rate matters. if we store samples for every route, costs blow up. need sampling controls and storage estimates in the rollout modal.

sophia: proposed per-rollout sampling config: `sample_rate` (0-100%), `retention_days`, `include_headers` (bool). default sample_rate = 0.5%. show storage estimate and monthly cost delta inline.

jamal: example config snippet we can expose in the API/console:

```
route: "/chat/compose"
autofallback:
  mode: "soft"
  sample_rate: 0.01
  quarantine: true
  reasons: ["latency","model_error"]
  retention_days: 7
```

oliver: also add an "operator-suggested-fix" field so reviewers can tag samples `model-temp`, `prompt-tweak`, `rate-limit`. index those tags for search & audits.

sophia: good idea — tags should be searchable and exportable for postmortems. include a "pin to rollback issue" action.

deploy-bot: note: rollout change to route `/chat/compose` will trigger a migration to samples table. estimated migration time ~30m.

maria: UX concern — avoid noisy inbox. we should group similar traces (cluster by similarity) and offer bulk actions: bulk-dismiss, bulk-assign, bulk-export. also caps per-route.

jamal: API endpoints we'll need: `GET /rollouts/{id}/quarantine?page=...&filter=...` and `POST /rollouts/{id}/quarantine/{sample_id}/annotate` and `POST /rollouts/{id}/quarantine/bulk_action`

sophia: agreed. next steps: I'll make a quick design mock + copy for privacy default. jamal can spike runtime sampling shim. maria owns privacy filter.

oliver: assigning: @jamal runtime spike, @maria privacy/filter, @sophia UX + mock. :thumbsup:

jamal: ack — starting spike tomorrow morning. :coffee:
